files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Add app icon (#110)
- Confirm saved raw link settings with a toast (#119)
- Refuse raw access on password-protected shares (#124)
- Accept /raw and /rss as absolute path_prefix in raw_csp (#125)

### Fixed

- Move app icon bottom edge closer to the chain link (#111)
- Load dialogs styles in the sidebar bundle (#118)

[0.9.0]: https://github.com/ernolf/files_sharing_raw/releases/tag/v0.9.0
